title: PersistedSourceDefinition
description: A reusable source as it is stored. It holds configuration and never a live capture session, decoder, or socket: 005 section 3.3 keeps runtime objects out of anything that can be serialized, and credentials appear only as references.

id.description: Stable source identifier, as a canonical hyphenated UUID (ADR-0069).

name.description: Display name, bounded because it is user text read back from an untrusted file.

kind.description: What kind of source this is. A closed set: an unknown kind is a compatibility diagnostic rather than a field the engine guesses at.
